offline.title: Instant & Offline
offline.desc: No waiting times, even without a connection. Always ready for the next entry.

focus.title: Clear Focus
focus.desc: Only the metrics that truly matter. No clutter, no stress.

design.title: Calm Design
design.desc: Warmth, balance, readability. Design that brings you peace.

designSection.title: Space for the essentials
designSection.desc: Every view is designed to keep you calm and focused: clear hierarchies, good readability, and no distractions. Make decisions at a glance.

why.title: Clarity instead of gut feeling
why.desc1: When everything is in one calm place, patterns become visible: where money flows, what matters, and where there's breathing room. This reduces stress and makes better decisions easy.
why.desc2: MoneyKoi is the simple, modern version of the paper budget book.

meta.title: Roadmap
meta.description: Planned features for Money Koi: Priorities, phases, and outlook.

header.title: Money Koi is evolving
header.subtitle: The most important steps first. Order may change – quality over speed.

phase1.title: Phase 1 · Focus & Foundation
phase1.desc: Essentials for family use and clear goals.

offline.title: Offline-only Mode
offline.desc: Fully usable without an account or server connection. Data remains exclusively on the device.

family.title: Family Account & Members
family.desc: Shared budgets, roles, and permissions for partners and family.

goals.title: Budget Goals & Tracking
goals.desc: Goals per category and month, real-time progress.

recurring.title: Recurring Transactions
recurring.desc: Subscriptions, rent, salary – automatically scheduled and clearly listed.

closing.title: Monthly Closing
closing.desc: Close the month, set carryovers, and save a brief summary.

transfers.title: Transfers Between Accounts
transfers.desc: Simple transfers with counter-entries and a clear history.

filters.title: Advanced Filters
filters.desc: Filter by period, account, category, amount, text, and combinations.

theme.title: Light Theme
theme.desc: Bright design as an alternative to the default dark look.

phase2.title: Phase 2 · Comfort & Efficiency
phase2.desc: Faster entry, better analysis, more convenient workflows.

web.title: Web Management
web.desc: Manage your budget book in the browser, ideal for keyboard power users.

photos.title: Save Photos
photos.desc: Attach receipts directly to transactions and easily find them again.

scan.title: Receipt Scan & Recognition
scan.desc: Extract text and amounts from receipts and pre-fill entries.

bulk.title: Bulk Entry
bulk.desc: Quickly save multiple items from a receipt one after another.

widgets.title: Android Widgets
widgets.desc: Quick access for entries, overview, and goals right on your home screen.

charts.title: More Analytics & Charts
charts.desc: Trends, histories, categories over time – presented calmly.

phase3.title: Phase 3 · Foresight & Extras
phase3.desc: Intelligence and motivation – later, once the foundation is solid.

forecasts.title: Forecasts
forecasts.desc: Expected monthly progression and remaining budget per category.

prompt.title: Quick Entry via Single Prompt
prompt.desc: One input, fully pre-filled transaction. Optional via voice.

voice.title: Voice Recording
voice.desc: Dictate transactions for quick entry on the go.

gamification.title: Gamification
gamification.desc: Leaderboards, quests, goals, and badges – optional and subtle.

aiStrategies.title: AI Savings Strategies
aiStrategies.desc: Suggestions tailored to your patterns, respectful and transparent.

aiReports.title: AI Reports & Recommendations
aiReports.desc: Monthly reports in plain text with gentle, actionable tips.

meta.title: Terms of Use
meta.description: Terms of use for Money Koi: account, data, prohibitions, liability, changes, and contact.

header.title: Terms of Use
header.subtitle: Basics of using Money Koi – scope, accounts, rules, liability, and changes.

one.title: 1. Provider, Scope
one.text: Contractual partner and operator of the app {app} is {name}, {address}. These terms govern the use of the mobile app. A web version with similar functions is planned and will be covered by these terms upon launch.

two.title: 2. Account & Registration
list: Login via Email OTP and Google OAuth.
An account can be used on multiple devices.
Currently, shared use within a family is possible via one account; in the future, separate family accounts within a shared tenant will be supported.
There is no rigid age limit; the app is de facto aimed at adult users. Use by minors is only permitted with the consent of legal guardians.

three.title: 3. Content & User Data
list: Processed data: login data (email), profile settings, accounts, categories, transactions.
Illegal, misleading, or harmful content is prohibited. Automated mass data entry, scraping, or bypassing security is forbidden.
Data export is currently not available and may be added later.

four.title: 4. Performance, Availability, Support
list: Provision on a best-effort basis, without a guarantee of permanent availability or being error-free.
Regular backups are performed; there is no claim to full restoration.
Support via email: {email}. Response usually within three business days.
Offline-First: Changes are automatically synchronized in the background when a connection is established.

five.title: 5. Prices, Payments, Cancellation
list: The service is currently free and ad-free.
A subscription model is planned (approx. €0.99/month) after completion of the first expansion phase. Processing via app stores where applicable.
When paid services are introduced, information regarding prices, terms, termination, and cancellation rights will be provided in advance.

six.title: 6. Third-party Providers & Transfers
list: Supabase as infrastructure/backend (EU region).
Website hosting and analytics via Vercel.
Sentry standard telemetry for stability; an opt-out option is offered within the app.
Planned email delivery service for login emails (e.g., Amazon service) may be added later.

seven.title: 7. Intellectual Property
list: App, content, designs, and trademarks remain the property of Gerald Gmainer.
Use of logos and screenshots for press/reviews is permitted within reasonable limits, provided Money Koi is correctly referenced.

eight.title: 8. Permissible Use
list: Prohibited are illegal content, harassment, abuse of services, bypassing technical protection measures, unauthorized automation, or sharing access data.
Commercial resale or rental of access is not permitted.

nine.title: 9. Termination & Suspension
list: Users can terminate their account at any time. Data is generally deleted within 30 days; backup copies may persist for a limited time.
In the event of serious violations, access may be suspended or terminated without notice.

ten.title: 10. Liability & Warranty
list: No guarantee is given for uninterrupted or error-free operation.
Liability for intent, gross negligence, as well as personal injury remains unaffected. Otherwise, liability is limited to foreseeable, contract-typical damages.

eleven.title: 11. Changes to Terms and Service
list: Factually justified adjustments to these terms or the service may be made.
Significant changes will be announced at least 14 days before taking effect in the app or via email. In case of objection, the right to terminate the account without notice exists.
Pure clarifications, bug fixes, and beneficial changes apply immediately.

twelve.title: 12. Applicable Law, Language
list: Austrian law applies, while maintaining mandatory consumer protection provisions of the state of residence.
The contract language is German. Translations are provided for clarity.
